items.title: BIRDY | Hung Dance
items.description: On November 28, Banff Centre Presents brings bold contemporary dance to the mountains with BIRDY, an electrifying work from Taiwan’s acclaimed Hung Dance.

items.title: Mo Valley Mile & 5K
items.description: The Mo Valley Mile & 5K is back for a third year in Banff! To promote physical and mental well-being during Movember, you can choose between a quick mile or a bit of a longer distance with a 5K.

items.title: On Other Archives Open Studios
items.description: Visit the studios of this fall’s thematic Visual Arts residency at Banff Centre, On Other Archives, which invited artists to think critically about the archive as a method or 'technology' for re-storying social and cultural narratives.

items.title: Laila Biali | Wintersongs
items.description: Grammy-nominated and JUNO Award-winning singer-songwriter and pianist Laila Biali returns to Banff Centre on December 2 with Wintersongs, a captivating musical celebration of the season inspired by the snowy Rocky Mountains. Reserve your seats now to enjoy a very merry holiday show.

items.description: This workshop is a mental health awareness and suicide prevention program funded by Alberta Health Services. items.title: Banff's draft budget prioritizes resident needs and sustainability
items.description: Residents are invited to participate in seven days of service review for budget deliberations about the services, programs and infrastructure investments that residents use and rely on every day.

items.title: Banff’s infrastructure investments build benefits for residents
items.description: 2026 construction season wraps up $77 million worth of investment in 47 projects - 98% on time and 98% on or below budget - providing the roadways, sewer and water systems, facilities and housing that Banffites need today and into the future.

items.title: CPKC Holiday Train — December 15
items.description: ?Celebrate the holiday season as the CPKC Holiday Train rolls into Banff.

items.title: Town of Banff brings more power to the people (in EVs)
items.description: The Town of Banff has installed six new electric vehicle (EV) charging stalls in the downtown Bear Street Parkade to help residents and visitors charge while working, shopping, accessing services and enjoying downtown Banff.

items.title: Banff Christmas Market — Nov. 19–Dec. 13
items.description: The 20256Banff Christmas Market is a magical holiday experience that blends the charm of a traditional Eropean market with the breathtaking beauty of the Canadian Rocky Mountains.

items.title: Blackfoot Confederacy and Town of Banff enter new phase of cooperation
items.description: Blackfoot Confederacy and the Town of Banff have formally signed a Memorandum of Understanding on communication and cooperation, establishing a framework for continued engagement, stronger working relationships and collaboration.

items.title: Mo Valley Mile & 5K — November 29
items.description: The Mo Valley Mile & 5K is back for a third year in Banff! To promote physical and mental well-being during Movember, you can choose between a quick mile or a bit of a longer distance with a 5K.

items.title: Winter Solstice Community Lantern Skate — December 21
items.description: Banff and Bow Valley residents, create your own beautiful lantern! We will all light up our lanterns for an evening skate, where we will enjoy some live local music and stay warm sipping hot tea by the fire.

items.title: Banff residents can now recycle more
items.description: Plastic bags, styrofoam, candy wrappers, coffee cups among materials that can now be diverted from landfill!

items.title: New drop-in recreation sessions offer more ways to use your Pauw Pass
items.description: From badminton to roller disco, and soccer to pickleball, there is something for everyone in the Town of Banff’s updated drop-in recreation schedule.
